item.title: Dot Link 0.5.7
item.description:
- If Dot Link times out while checking for an existing installation, you can now choose Copy report code beside Check again. It copies the app version, build number and error code together for support.
If you are updating from 0.5.4 or earlier, open Plugins in ChatGPT, choose your existing Dot Link connection, then open Settings and select Update tools. Finish any work in progress and restart the same Dot from its chat menu.
If you share Mac notifications and are updating from 0.5.3 or earlier, grant Dot Link Accessibility access once after installation. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, remove the old Dot Link entry, add the installed Dot Link.app again and turn it on.
